summary.key_finding: Medical Missions Foundation operates with minimal development/fundraising staff. Organization has 2 full-time equivalent staff (ED + Mission Support Manager) with no dedicated development, donor relations, advancement, or major gifts roles. 11 board members identified, with top leadership being Lisa Heath MD (President) and Amanda Gray (Secretary). Organization relies primarily on volunteer medical professionals for mission delivery and board members for governance/strategy.
